newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand says 1997 Q1 exports up 1.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand says 1997 Q1 exports up 1.5 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Monday said exports during January-March of 1997 rose 1.5 percent year on year.
He said export growth in April alone was about four-five percent.
The figure differed from that of the Commerce Ministry which estimated the export growth during the first quarter this year at 3.0 percent. This is due to the different methods of calculation.
The central bank export and import data was obtained through the transfer of ownership between residents and non-residents for the purpose of analysing the country's balance of payments positions.
